unit: JPY per first outpatient visit (initial consultation fee, excluding surcharges), insurance price

baseline.source: 初診料 291点 x 1点=10円. 291点: 医科診療報酬点数表 区分A000 (令和6年度改定, https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/12404000/001251499.pdf) and unchanged by the 令和8年度改定 (before/after both 291点, https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/12400000/001672521.pdf; R8 adds a separate 2-point 外来・在宅物価対応料 surcharge not counted here). 1点=10円: 診療報酬の算定方法 (平成20年厚生労働省告示第59号) 二, https://www.mhlw.go.jp/web/t_doc?dataId=84aa9729&dataType=0&pageNo=1

notes: baseline: regulated insurance price (patient pays a share); a floor-and-ceiling price, not the provider's cost to serve. with_bot must come from costs of work this repo's actor actually processed (n_events >= 30); never simulated.
